name: Useless Wait
hint: This smell identifies a [wait] block in a script branch where no meaningful behavior follows it and it does not serve loop timing. The delay then cannot postpone an observable action and makes the control flow harder to understand.
instruction: Remove the wait, or place it before behavior that genuinely needs to be delayed. In a loop, keep a wait only when it deliberately controls the loop's timing.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
move (10) steps
if <touching color [#2727c2] ?> then
wait (1) seconds
else
wait until <mouse down?>
end
